name: Allopurinol
description: A xanthine oxidase inhibitor approved for gout, for hyperuricaemia of malignancy and for recurrent calcium oxalate calculi. Carries a warning for severe cutaneous adverse reactions, whose risk is strongly associated with the HLA-B*58:01 allele.

systems.note: Urate lowering through xanthine oxidase inhibition; the labelled indication.
Hepatotoxicity including granulomatous hepatitis is documented.
Bone marrow suppression is labelled, as is DRESS with eosinophilia.
Renally cleared; dose reduction is labelled in renal impairment.

monitors.why: The direct index of the effect the drug is given for.
Labelled bone marrow suppression and DRESS.
